ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $C$ is a point on line segment $AB$, and $D$ is the midpoint of line segment $BC$. If $AB=10$ and $AC=6$, find the length of $AD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $C$ is a point on line segment $AB$, $AB=10$, $AC=6$,\\
thus $BC=AB-AC=10-6=4$,\\
since $D$ is the midpoint of line segment $BC$,\\
thus $BD=\frac{1}{2}BC=2$,\\
therefore $AD=AB-BD=10-2=\boxed{8}$.
